verdict.rationale: Simular documents recurring autonomous automation. Sai can be taught a task once, saved as a replayable parameterized skill, and rerun on a schedule. It keeps running on cloud computers after the user closes the laptop and notifies the user only when approval is needed. Saved code self-heals when the UI changes. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how schedules are configured (cron syntax, triggers, management), independent or hands-on corroboration of unattended scheduled runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Teach it once, and Sai reruns on a schedule, getting more reliable and cost-efficient each time.
